trans-unit.source: The app needs to modify the system configuration to save the edited display data.

trans-unit.note: Privacy - Access to a File Provide Domain Usage Description

trans-unit.source: This app needs local network access when its integration features are configured accordingly.
trans-unit.target: Táto aplikácia potrebuje prístup k lokálnej sieti, keď sú jej integračné funkcie nastavené na jej používanie.

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, the app will not send crash reports to the developer. Crash reporting is handled by Sentry (sentry.io).
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, the app will not send crash reports to the developer. Crash reporting is handled by Sentry (sentry.io).
trans-unit.target: Ak tieto pripojenia zakážete, aplikácia nebude vývojárovi odosielať hlásenia o pádoch. Hlásenia o pádoch spracúva služba Sentry (sentry.io).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be able to purchase or activate a Pro license. Licensing is managed by Paddle (paddle.com).
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, you will not be able to purchase or activate a Pro license. Licensing is managed by Paddle (paddle.com).
trans-unit.target: Ak tieto pripojenia zakážete, nebudete môcť zakúpiť ani aktivovať licenciu Pro. Správu licencií zabezpečuje Paddle (paddle.com).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.
trans-unit.target: Ak tieto pripojenia zakážete, nebudete dostávať oznámenia o nových verziách ani nebudete môcť aktualizovať aplikáciu prostredníctvom jej používateľského rozhrania.

trans-unit.id: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a smart TV, amplifier) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.source: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a smart TV, amplifier) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.target: V aplikácii môžete vytvárať vlastné sieťové ovládacie prvky (napríklad na ovládanie zariadenia s podporou siete, ako je televízor alebo zosilňovač), ktoré sa môžu pripájať k ľubovoľným hostiteľom, ktorých zadáte v lokálnej sieti alebo na internete. Ak tieto pripojenia zakážete, tieto vlastné ovládacie prvky nebudú fungovať.

trans-unit.id:
%@ must restart to apply the imported settings.
If you imported settings from a different installation, macOS display identifiers (UUIDs) may not match this installation. As a result, various imported settings may not get immediately applied to the connected displays.
Use the 'Transfer display settings' feature under all affected displays' additional settings to fix the identifier mismatch issue.
trans-unit.source:
%@ must restart to apply the imported settings.
If you imported settings from a different installation, macOS display identifiers (UUIDs) may not match this installation. As a result, various imported settings may not get immediately applied to the connected displays.
Use the 'Transfer display settings' feature under all affected displays' additional settings to fix the identifier mismatch issue.
trans-unit.target:
Na použitie importovaných nastavení sa musí aplikácia %@ reštartovať.
Ak ste importovali nastavenia z inej inštalácie, identifikátory displejov macOS (UUID) nemusia zodpovedať tejto inštalácii. Niektoré importované nastavenia sa preto nemusia okamžite použiť na pripojené displeje.
Nesúlad identifikátorov vyriešite funkciou „Preniesť nastavenia displeja“ v ďalších nastaveniach všetkých dotknutých displejov.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Settings import restart alert. Transfer display settings associates imported settings with the current display identifiers.

This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.

**%@ – Zistený problém s licenciou**
Táto inštalácia bola na diaľku deaktivovaná alebo sa od poslednej aktivácie licencie zmenili hardvérové identifikátory. Mohlo k tomu dôjsť po inovácii hardvéru alebo prechode na nové zariadenie.

trans-unit.id:

This license no longer covers the current app version (v%@). To use this version of %@, please purchase a new license.
Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.

trans-unit.id: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.source: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.target: Aplikácia použije načítané EDID pri pripojení tohto displeja. Obrazovka pritom blikne a prepne režim, ak existujúci režim nie je s aktualizovaným EDID dostupný. Ak má nové EDID odlišné identifikačné údaje (výrobca, model, sériové číslo), displej sa rozpozná ako iný. Podržaním ⇧ Shift pri spustení zapnete bezpečný režim a zabránite automatickému použitiu. Pri vážnych problémoch fyzicky odpojte a znovu pripojte displej, aby ste obnovili pôvodný stav.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Automatic EDID application safety and recovery help.

trans-unit.id: The device doesn’t support range-based volume control (i.e., setting a specific level on a scale between a minimum and maximum). trans-unit.source: The device doesn’t support range-based volume control (i.e., setting a specific level on a scale between a minimum and maximum). It does support remote-style volume up/down and mute toggles, which works well for keyboard control. Volume control may not work optimally if an AV receiver is connected and HDMI‑CEC is handling volume between the TV and the receiver.

Ovládanie hlasitosti nemusí fungovať optimálne, ak je pripojený AV prijímač a HDMI‑CEC spravuje hlasitosť medzi televízorom a prijímačom.

trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Pri zapnutom zvýšení jasu HDR a vypnutom hardvérovom ovládaní jasu aplikácia používa plynulú stupnicu od nuly po kalibrované maximum zvýšenia. Neutrálne nastavenie (jas 100⁠%, pri ktorom sa neorezáva rozsah obsahu HDR) preto nemusí pripadnúť na hranicu dielika OSD a môže byť ťažko dostupné skratkami. Preto sa vloží dodatočný medzikrok na úrovni jasu 100⁠%.

trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Používa sa alternatívna identita EDID – zmeny systémovej konfigurácie sa priradia k tejto identite!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Display configuration warning when overridden EDID identification data is active; system settings are associated with that identity, not the original one.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Another controller (%@) is taking precedence for %@.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Another controller (%1$@) is taking precedence for %2$@.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Controller conflict warning; placeholders identify the controller and affected control or device.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ CLI designation clashes with the designation of an existing control.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ CLI designation clashes with the designation of an existing control.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Označenie CLI je v konflikte s označením existujúceho ovládacieho prvku.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Custom control validation: CLI designations must be unique.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Connection mode was automatically switched to Simple Manifest because the full manifest signature was denied by the device.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Connection mode was automatically switched to Simple Manifest because the full manifest signature was denied by the device.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Režim pripojenia sa automaticky zmenil na Simple Manifest, pretože zariadenie odmietlo podpis úplného manifestu.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Device connection status for fallback to the Simple Manifest protocol mode.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ EDID data cannot be interpreted (might be invalid).
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ EDID data cannot be interpreted (might be invalid).
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Údaje EDID sa nedajú interpretovať (môžu byť neplatné).
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Warning for unparseable display identification data.
53477 - Warning when display identification data could not be retrieved.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ EDID write is not available for the supplied EDID as its size exceeds 256 bytes.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ EDID write is not available for the supplied EDID as its size exceeds 256 bytes.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Zadané EDID sa nedá zapísať, pretože jeho veľkosť presahuje 256 bajtov.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - EDID write size limit warning; the supplied data exceeds 256 bytes.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ For best results, stick close to the display aspect ratio!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ For best results, stick close to the display aspect ratio!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Najlepšie výsledky dosiahnete, ak sa budete držať blízko pomeru strán displeja!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Aspect ratio advice for custom display dimensions or resolutions.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ For this XDR display it is best to set calibration to Default - Auto Calibrate so the app can automatically adapt upscaling to the currently selected Apple Display Preset and environmental factors. For manual calibration set the brightness slider as high as possible while also making sure you still see the smiling face!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ For this XDR display it is best to set calibration to Default - Auto Calibrate so the app can automatically adapt upscaling to the currently selected Apple Display Preset and environmental factors. For manual calibration set the brightness slider as high as possible while also making sure you still see the smiling face!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Pre tento displej XDR je najlepšie nastaviť kalibráciu na Predvolené – Automatická kalibrácia, aby aplikácia mohla automaticky prispôsobovať zvýšenie jasu aktuálne vybranej predvoľbe displeja Apple a podmienkam prostredia. Pri ručnej kalibrácii nastavte posuvník jasu čo najvyššie, pričom usmievajúca sa tvár musí zostať viditeľná!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - XDR brightness upscaling calibration help; the smiling face is a visual calibration target.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Full screen streaming is unavailable as it requires Screen Recording permissions. You can grant this under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Full screen streaming is unavailable as it requires Screen Recording permissions. You can grant this under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Streamovanie na celú obrazovku nie je dostupné, pretože vyžaduje povolenie na nahrávanie obrazovky. Udeliť ho môžete v časti Systémové nastavenia > Súkromie a bezpečnosť > Nahrávanie obrazovky!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Full-screen streaming permission warning pointing to macOS Screen Recording settings.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ If a third party app is being used to show the OSD, you might want to disable the built-in OSD under Keyboard/OSD to avoid having duplicated or mixed-style OSDs presented!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ If a third party app is being used to show the OSD, you might want to disable the built-in OSD under Keyboard/OSD to avoid having duplicated or mixed-style OSDs presented!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Ak na zobrazovanie OSD používate aplikáciu tretej strany, môžete vypnúť vstavané OSD v časti Klávesnica/OSD, aby sa nezobrazovali duplicitné indikátory alebo indikátory s rôznymi štýlmi!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - OSD integration help: disable the built-in on-screen indicator when using a third-party provider.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ If you want to mirror/stream the virtual screen to a natively connected display only to get flexible HiDPI resolutions, it is recommended to use the flexible scaling feature instead if possible! If you want to use mirroring instead of streaming, this can be enabled in the app menu once the virtual screen is connected.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ If you want to mirror/stream the virtual screen to a natively connected display only to get flexible HiDPI resolutions, it is recommended to use the flexible scaling feature instead if possible! If you want to use mirroring instead of streaming, this can be enabled in the app menu once the virtual screen is connected.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Ak chcete virtuálnu obrazovku zrkadliť alebo streamovať na natívne pripojený displej iba kvôli flexibilným rozlíšeniam HiDPI, odporúčame namiesto toho použiť flexibilné škálovanie, ak je dostupné! Ak chcete namiesto streamovania používať zrkadlenie, môžete ho povoliť v menu aplikácie po pripojení virtuálnej obrazovky.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Virtual screen help recommending flexible scaling for native displays when only flexible HiDPI resolutions are needed.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Intel Macs do not support software brightness upscaling while color-table adjustments are enabled. Disable color-table control to use the compositor or Metal overlay path.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Intel Macs do not support software brightness upscaling while color-table adjustments are enabled. Disable color-table control to use the compositor or Metal overlay path.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Macy s procesorom Intel nepodporujú softvérové zvýšenie jasu pri zapnutých úpravách tabuľky farieb. Ak chcete používať kompozitor alebo prekrývaciu vrstvu Metal, vypnite ovládanie tabuľky farieb.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Intel GPU limitation affecting software brightness upscaling with color-table adjustments.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ It is recommended to have more leeway in the range!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ It is recommended to have more leeway in the range!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Odporúčame ponechať v rozsahu väčšiu rezervu!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Warning when configured minimum and maximum resolution dimensions leave too little flexibility.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Layout protection is disabled for this display group.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Layout protection is disabled for this display group.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Ochrana rozloženia je pre túto skupinu displejov vypnutá.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Metal performance might be degraded on this device with an integrated Intel GPU.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Metal performance might be degraded on this device with an integrated Intel GPU.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Výkon technológie Metal môže byť na tomto zariadení s integrovaným GPU Intel znížený.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Metal rendering performance warning for integrated Intel graphics.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Minimum width/height value should be lower than the maximum!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Minimum width/height value should be lower than the maximum!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Minimálna šírka/výška musí byť menšia než maximálna!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Validation warning for minimum and maximum display dimensions.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Missing or duplicated identifier present - this will yield unexpected results!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Missing or duplicated identifier present - this will yield unexpected results!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Chýba identifikátor alebo je duplicitný – výsledky budú neočakávané!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Validation warning for missing or duplicate identifiers.

trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Nie sú dostupné žiadne skupiny displejov.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Empty state warning when no display groups exist.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Notifications are turned off for the app. Fix this under System Settings > Notifications!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Notifications are turned off for the app. Fix this under System Settings > Notifications!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Hlásenia sú pre aplikáciu vypnuté. Zapnite ich v časti Systémové nastavenia > Hlásenia!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - macOS notification permission warning; Notifications is the system settings pane, not software updates.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Remote control operations seem to be denied by the unit with the selected connection mode.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Remote control operations seem to be denied by the unit with the selected connection mode.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Zariadenie zrejme odmieta operácie diaľkového ovládania pri vybranom režime pripojenia.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Device controller warning for denied remote operations under the selected connection mode.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Requires appropriate configuration on the device: disabled 'Auto Power Sync' or 'HDMI-CEC' to avoid control conflict and enabled 'QuickStart+', 'Always Ready' and 'Turn on via Wi-Fi' ('Networked Standby').
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Requires appropriate configuration on the device: disabled 'Auto Power Sync' or 'HDMI-CEC' to avoid control conflict and enabled 'QuickStart+', 'Always Ready' and 'Turn on via Wi-Fi' ('Networked Standby').
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Vyžaduje príslušné nastavenie zariadenia: vypnuté „Auto Power Sync“ alebo „HDMI-CEC“, aby sa predišlo konfliktu ovládania, a zapnuté „QuickStart+“, „Always Ready“ a „Turn on via Wi-Fi“ („Networked Standby“).
trans-unit.note: 53477 - TV power control prerequisites; retain recognizable device firmware setting names.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Software upscaling is active while direct control and XDR upscaling is also allowed. Turn off '%@' in the app menu first and then activate '%@' in the app menu to use this feature.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Software upscaling is active while direct control and XDR upscaling is also allowed. Turn off '%1$@' in the app menu first and then activate '%2$@' in the app menu to use this feature.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Softvérové zvýšenie jasu je aktívne, pričom je povolené aj priame ovládanie a zvýšenie jasu XDR. Ak chcete používať túto funkciu, najprv v menu aplikácie vypnite „%@“ a potom zapnite „%@“.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Brightness upscaling conflict warning; placeholders are the menu settings to disable and enable.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Synchronization is disabled for this display group.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Synchronization is disabled for this display group.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Synchronizácia je pre túto skupinu displejov vypnutá.

trans-unit.source: ⚠️ The protection is not in effect unless all participating displays are connected.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Ochrana sa neuplatní, kým nie sú pripojené všetky zúčastnené displeje.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Group protection prerequisite requiring every participating display.

trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Ochrana sa neuplatní, kým nie je definovaná relatívna poloha.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Layout protection prerequisite requiring a relative display position.

trans-unit.note: 53477 - Audio device control warning for devices without native volume support.

trans-unit.source: ⚠️ The specified audio device is not found or currently unavailable.

trans-unit.source: ⚠️ The system OSD is available for brightness and volume only and may not show the correct device name and value on this macOS version.

trans-unit.note: 53477 - System OSD compatibility warning; only brightness and volume are supported.

trans-unit.source: ⚠️ There is no custom control configured suitable as a new custom DDC feature.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Nie je nakonfigurovaný žiadny vlastný ovládací prvok vhodný ako nová vlastná funkcia DDC.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ This OSD style is available for brightness and volume only.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ This OSD style is available for brightness and volume only.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Tento štýl OSD je dostupný iba pre jas a hlasitosť.

trans-unit.source: ⚠️ This display does not support color table adjustments or color table adjustments are disabled. The app uses overlay based dimming instead.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Tento displej nepodporuje úpravy tabuľky farieb alebo sú tieto úpravy vypnuté. Aplikácia namiesto toho používa stlmenie pomocou prekrývacej vrstvy.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Software dimming fallback when color-table adjustments cannot be used.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ This feature is not available in this version.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ This feature is not available in this version.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Táto funkcia nie je v tejto verzii dostupná.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Feature availability warning for the current app version.

trans-unit.id:
⚠️ This operation might permanently render your display unusable!
Are you sure you want to continue?
trans-unit.source:
⚠️ This operation might permanently render your display unusable!
Are you sure you want to continue?
trans-unit.target:
⚠️ Táto operácia môže váš displej natrvalo znefunkčniť!
Naozaj chcete pokračovať?
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Confirmation warning before a potentially destructive display hardware operation.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ This setting is known to cause lack of signal on wake for some adapters, including the built-in HDMI port of several Mac models.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ This setting is known to cause lack of signal on wake for some adapters, including the built-in HDMI port of several Mac models.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Je známe, že toto nastavenie spôsobuje stratu signálu po prebudení pri niektorých adaptéroch vrátane vstavaného portu HDMI viacerých modelov Macu.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Display connection setting warning about missing signal after wake.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ This setting may prevent DisplayLink displays from showing the overlay effect and, with some DisplayLink driver versions, may lead to increased CPU usage. It also prevents dimming and color adjustments from taking effect in screen streams and PIP windows.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ This setting may prevent DisplayLink displays from showing the overlay effect and, with some DisplayLink driver versions, may lead to increased CPU usage. It also prevents dimming and color adjustments from taking effect in screen streams and PIP windows.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Toto nastavenie môže zabrániť zobrazovaniu efektu prekrývacej vrstvy na displejoch DisplayLink a pri niektorých verziách ovládača DisplayLink môže zvýšiť využitie CPU. Zároveň zabraňuje uplatneniu stlmenia a úprav farieb v streamoch obrazovky a oknách PIP.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Overlay setting warning for DisplayLink and captured streams/PIP windows.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Unable to enable DDC due to display or connection issues.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Unable to enable DDC due to display or connection issues.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ DDC sa nedá zapnúť pre problémy s displejom alebo pripojením.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Visualization is not indicative as the display is not in the proper orientation for this layout protection configuration!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Visualization is not indicative as the display is not in the proper orientation for this layout protection configuration!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Náhľad nie je smerodajný, pretože displej nemá správnu orientáciu pre túto konfiguráciu ochrany rozloženia!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Layout protection preview warning when the display orientation differs from the configured layout.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Volume control is configured to use an audio device with native volume control. This prevents this control from being accessible even if the capability is enabled.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ Volume control is configured to use an audio device with native volume control. This prevents this control from being accessible even if the capability is enabled.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Hlasitosť je nastavená na ovládanie cez zvukové zariadenie so systémovým ovládaním hlasitosti. Preto tento ovládací prvok nie je dostupný, aj keď je jeho funkcia povolená.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Control availability warning when native audio device volume takes precedence.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ macOS already supports standby/wake over HDMI-CEC with most compatible hardware - leave this off to avoid conflict.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ macOS already supports standby/wake over HDMI-CEC with most compatible hardware - leave this off to avoid conflict.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ macOS už podporuje pohotovostný režim a prebudenie cez HDMI-CEC s väčšinou kompatibilného hardvéru. Túto voľbu nechajte vypnutú, aby ste predišli konfliktu.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - HDMI-CEC power control help warning about conflicts with native macOS behavior.
